open: Q-S1b: an X passing (I') whose realised subsets per label word / eligible pattern are e^{o(M)} / e^{o(h)}
threshold_note: Theorem C needs q > k^3 lambda m_*: at a = 0.49 false at k = 2^1024 (log lambda ~ 3.1 log q), true at k = 2^4096
positive_answer_gives: every c with 2c < (gamma - eps) b, no ceiling from the template; passing 1/8 needs b > 1/2 and Q-S1b at those parameters; Q-S1b is the only lock
